_comment: Template only. Copy to a private path (e.g. work/agents/client/dual-track-pipeline/pipeline.json). Paths only; signing material comes from runner environment variables MLTD_KEYSTORE/MLTD_KEY_ALIAS/MLTD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/MLTD_KEY_PASSWORD and MLTD_RELEASE_SIGNER_SHA256. nas.asset_host_resolve is an optional curl-style host:port:ip pin used when the asset host DNS is AAAA-only and the runner has no IPv6 path (HEAD falls back to the OS resolver when null). tracks.*.asset_pin is optional: the last verified {index_name, index_sha256} for a pinned asset release; it powers the serving-path diagnostic when the NAS control path is down and fails closed if the NAS index changes.
